title: Loose Powder
text:
Loose Powder. I do not know if you can see the black powder on the countertop in the picture since Amazon typically shows pictures as smaller size. However, I assure you there is a lot of black powder. When I unwrapped the plastic I gently set the filter down on my counter. I then discarded my old Alen filter. When I picked up this new filter off the counter I immediately saw it left behind a lot of black powder.

The genuine Alen filters do not leave behind any black powder. I bought this generic one because I wanted to save the $30. I should have just spent the extra $30. This generic replacement filter is way too inferior.
